name: Toomi Satoru
source:
The protagonist. A high school student and part time worker at a family restaurant called "Lavage" he loves playing eroge.

His life turns upside-down when he runs into a "love angel" and it turns out he's special because he's full of romantic energy from the love of many girls, even if none of them are actually real!

In CGs his hair is sometimes black and sometimes brown.

[spoiler]He's actually good-looking and popular around girls. at least until the girl find out that he's actually an eroge lover. He had a girlfriend once, but he got dumped immediately after his girlfriend found out about his hobby, making him distrust real-life girls and went deeper into eroge.[/spoiler]
